correctness.rationale: All quantifiers are covered by a four-step analytic proof: explicit normalized star entries, exact Jacobian absolute row sums, monotone reduction to one free spoke, and scalar critical-point analysis. The \(m=18\) polynomial factorization with a positive squares decomposition proves uniform optimality at all lower degrees; a strict rational \(m=19\) witness plus monotonicity of normalized comparison in leaf count proves the switch; derivative sign and radical roots establish the unique heavy-spoke branch. Interior directional derivatives approximate boundary optima, while convex-line integration proves the full two-input coefficient. The limit follows by radical asymptotics. Standalone checker passed 14,202 counted supplementary tests; tests are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The invariant is the exact worst-case robustness coefficient of a canonical symmetric graph shift under directly specified per-edge absolute errors, not an arbitrary coordinate slice. It isolates a discrete geometry transition at nineteen leaves and a positive limiting sensitivity that would be hidden by restricting spoke imbalance to a fixed ratio. The full all-degree closed formula and sharp asymptotic are natural baseline data for stability of normalized spectral graph operators; this value does not depend on extrapolating a theorem to arbitrary graphs.
